description: This file defines a React component 'PaymentDetailClient' for displaying and editing payment details within a shop management frontend. It includes logic to load payment info via API calls, handle form state for editing, and render different views including an overview and an edit form with various related data.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats a number as a currency string based on the specified currency code.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to a locale-specific date string; returns '-' if invalid.

methods.name: toDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts an ISO date string to yyyy-mm-dd format suitable for date input value.

methods.name: fromDateInputValue
methods.description: Converts a date string in yyyy-mm-dd format to an ISO string.

methods.name: statusVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string for invoice status badges based on status.

methods.name: methodVariant
methods.description: Returns a variant string for payment method badges based on method.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form data and returns an object with errors for invalid fields.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads payment and related invoice and customer data from the API, updating component state.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Handles form submission to save updated payment details, with optimistic UI update and error handling.
